body:
Parent: #1911
Depends on: #2120, #1909, #2105, #2106, #2107

## 原子目标

执行verified conflict resolution plans，通过#1909 canonical server writer与local materializer提交已解决结果，并为server/local失败、crash、cancel和partial materialization建立exact recovery/rollback journals。该issue只负责执行与恢复语义，不实现merge算法、Git facts或UI。

## 必须交付

1. Executor只接受#2120 current verified plan/ref/digest，执行前再次验证stale coordinates、permissions、Git markers/operations与dependencies。
2. 执行前生成local backup/materialization journal与server expected revision set，绑定plan/operation/article identities与content digests。
3. Server writes只走#2105 canonical writer，local writes只走#2106 materializer；不得direct SQL/filesystem、import fallback或新writer。
4. 服务端写入失败时不写local new base；local materialization失败时状态为recovery-required，server result/history保留且不能标synced。
5. Recovery只消费exact plan/checkpoint/journal/receipt refs，不扫描latest文件/receipt或按mtime猜状态。
6. Crash/network/agent/browser/Git interruption可从last sealed checkpoint继续，重验current facts；漂移则阻止旧recovery并要求新plan。
7. 用户可撤销尚未完成的local materialization；若server revision已正式生成，undo必须创建新canonical revision，绝不删除/改写历史。
8. All-or-nothing groups失败时未提交部分回滚；已提交server transaction有明确recovery obligations与user-visible state。
9. Retry/idempotency绑定same plan/result/journal，不重复server revisions、local files或audit/outbox。
10. Backup/conflict data容量、TTL、encryption/privacy classification与cleanup policy明确；不永久保留全文副本，不在普通logs/artifacts泄漏source。
11. Journal状态closed/versioned，至少覆盖prepared/server-committing/server-committed/local-materializing/recovery-required/recovered/rolled-forward/cancelled/failed/complete。
12. Independent verifier检查plan→server→local→base→journal/receipt双向一致、state transitions与cleanup/tamper。

## 固定约束

- 不实现taxonomy/source/metadata merge/Git observer/resolution plan。
- 不提供conflict UI。
- 不修改#1909 planner/writer/materializer业务语义。
- 不按latest/mtime恢复，不删除server history。
- 不修改#1794。

## 必须测试

- server failure before local；
- server success/local failure仍synced；
- crash at each journal state；
- network/agent/browser interruption；
- Git state changes during recovery；
- stale plan/journal自动continue；
- latest receipt recovery；
- duplicate retry revisions/files；
- undo删除server history；
- all-or-nothing partial group；
- backup TTL/capacity/cleanup；
- source/secret leakage；
- journal/receipt/base tamper。

## 验收条件

- [ ] Resolution execution只走canonical server/local authorities。
- [ ] 任一partial/crash/cancel有exact durable recovery obligation，不伪装synced。
- [ ] Recovery只使用exact receipts/checkpoints且遇drift fail closed。
- [ ] Server history不可删除，undo通过新revision。
- [ ] Journals/backup privacy、TTL与cleanup可验证。

## 非目标

- 不实现merge/plans/Git facts。
- 不提供冲突UI。
- 不实现dependency materialization具体逻辑。
- 不执行terminal browser/E2E。

Please supply the canonical admission bridge from verified #2120 decisions/results to a new sealed execution bundle, without mutating or clearing the original blocked plan. #1865 owner #3560 please supply actual closed portable manifest/byte/path APIs at an exact commit (typed metadata identity validation is not portable mapping).

Independent Git facts and immutable plan/journal validation source work proceeds now where existing APIs suffice. This is a callable-contract request, not a wait on OPEN/unmerged status. No acceptance, merge, closure, deployment or package publishing claimed.

#2133 product navigation owner requests exact source SHA for current journal/checkpoint/result reader plus closed recovery/roll-forward/undo allowed commands and stable real UI/router/command binding (coordinate/plan/operation/article/site/vault/journal refs and digests, return/focus). Existing browser articleRecoveryJournal is draft recovery only and will not substitute for Vault authority. Current dedicated read-only plan/server-result presentation at b2c57cbc905fe0057699cb58274975ff483cfbfe / draft #3942 keeps server committed facts visible and local/base unknown. Need real materialization/current-receipt and recovery capabilities for actual navigation/clean completion, not a stub target.

Independent vault-crash-replay QA consumed exact scalar-plan/journal source bb49a4c1f579ddf8630c67776d6cd9fa1f8c0661. Actual Shared build exits 0; separate diagnostic export/verify processes exercise canonical scalar metadata -> conflict evidence -> resolution proposal -> Prepared/ServerCommitting/RecoveryRequired history serialization. Seven structural/composite checks passed, exit 0: exact-tip chain verified, stale tip and missing predecessor refused, resumed plan after expiry reports article_vault_plan_expired, Complete without server/local/base references rejected, RequireExecutionAdmission reports article_vault_resolution_canonical_execution_admission_missing, and RequireRecoveryAdmission reports article_vault_recovery_canonical_materializer_and_operation_admission_missing even for a structurally valid chain. These are explicitly controlled contract fixtures; refs do NOT establish backup/native/server artifacts or durable journal execution.

Published journal API at this SHA is pure structure/history/admission only: no durable recovery adapter, real backup authority, canonical conflict-resolution execution bridge or native base/materializer exists. Consequently accepted-server crash/local-commit/resume/undo/cleanup tests remain untested/WIP, not an emulated pass. #2107 separate real PostgreSQL/independent-PID crash evidence has been handed to its owner. No new product defect observed in these bounded checks; production and shared integrations untouched. Reproducible test-only handoff follows.
